name: Civil Engineering
motto: Slow to arrive, slower to leave.

cards.name: Excavator
cards.about: The toughest wall of all. Very slow.

cards.name: Road Roller
cards.about: A wall that rolls straight ahead, mud or not.

cards.name: Site Engineer
cards.about: Cheap long-range shooter. Keep it behind a wall.

cards.name: Crane Operator
cards.about: Short-range shooter with a heavy punch.

cards.name: Seismic Crew
cards.about: Its tremor also hurts everyone next to the target.

cards.name: Surveyor
cards.about: Quick, sturdy for its price, and sticks to the road.

cards.name: Construction Crew
cards.about: Very fast, very fragile. Cuts straight through mud.

cards.name: Survey Drone
cards.about: Floats over grass and mud. Shoots from two tiles away.
